newsitem.title: USA: U.S. to sell $30 bln of cash bills June 2.
newsitem.headline: U.S. to sell $30 bln of cash bills June 2.

text.p: The U.S. Treasury said on Tuesday that it will auction $30 billion of 14-day cash management bills on June 2.
The bills will be issued June 3 and mature on June 17.
Minimum bids will be in amounts of $10,000.
Noncompetitive tenders on both maturities will be accepted in full up to $1 million at the average discount rate of accepted competitive bids, which must be received by 1 p.m. EDT (1700 GMT).
The CUSIP number for the bills will be 9127946Z2.
